protocol.name: original-three-pair-native
protocol.warmup: Only small prepare/estimate/HTTP send, after code aging. Large remains cold for its first measured send. Source setup precedes aging exactly as before; no native large pre-fill.
protocol.algorithm: Per-send peaks use max(0, settledReading - previous quiet baseline). Growth is median(three large peaks) - median(three small peaks), signed and compared <=1048576 independently for heap and ArrayBuffers. Retention is max(Theil-Sen slope of six heaps *5, Theil-Sen slope of six ArrayBuffer readings *5), compared <=1048576. Endpoint growth is reported, not judged. No offset/noise subtraction. Partial pairs have no original gate verdict.
protocol.route: For each successful send require exactly one actual NativeChatBody stream, exactly one production estimate with positive token count, and zero WireBodySpool creates/PromptEstimatorFiles writes. Exactly one HTTP request. Fixed independent legacy-converter hash/bytes and Content-Length. Retention sends enforce route and stable hash in the probe.
protocol.ownership: Provider probe owns production HistoryService/journal selections; persistent ROW commits stream one row at a time. An eager test-only converter oracle runs in the parent outside measurement. No expected whole-body buffer enters provider memory. Separate sink incrementally hashes HTTP bytes and holds scalar metadata only.

protocol.name: separate-native-warm-plain-chat-1pair-6retention
protocol.nativeWarmup: One separately costed actual prepare/estimate/HTTP send of each size, equally for text and tools.
protocol.unchanged: Thresholds, Theil-Sen retained predicate, settledHeap, GC settings, engine settings, quiet-baseline schedule and 180000 ms file timeout.
protocol.noSpecial5MiBThreshold: The actual sendPeak contract has a 1 MiB large-minus-small growth and retained-trend allowance. Its eager traps hold original row arrays and do not use a separate fixed 5 MiB threshold.
protocol.peakMeaning: peakHeap and peakArrayBuffers are increases over each send baseline; peakRss is provider-probe resident bytes. Absolute retained readings remain in each series.

owningProcesses.oracle: Parent setup process computes independent old-converter bodies outside child measurement; only hashes/counts cross to the result. No expected 8 MiB body is retained in the measured provider probe.
owningProcesses.provider: Bun probe owns native HistoryService, pinned sources, provider, runtime tokenizer and memory sampling.
owningProcesses.sink: Separate HTTP child incrementally hashes network chunks; it owns socket buffers, hash state and scalar request metadata, not a complete buffered body. Sink memory/CPU is not included in provider readings.

protocol.observerState: Only scalar native-route counts and the existing capped 64 WeakRefs; no row map or body copy.
protocol.costUnits: elapsedMs and process.cpuUsage microseconds belong to the provider probe including setup/sampling; journalBytesAdded is exact net journal subtree size growth, not cumulative write bytes. Darwin fsRead/fsWrite are uninterpreted kernel counters.
limitations: One measured pair is not the original three-pair native protocol.
Warm zero net journal growth is not a physical-read or no-I/O proof.
One live pin per size and six sends do not establish aggregate cache/pin/overlay capacity.

rootEvidence.confirmed: The original cold-large native path exceeds the budget left for three pairs and six retained sends. The first text large send took 123236.105084 ms, created 24951030 net journal bytes and produced 2100 samples; the next large send took 4909.600083 ms with zero net journal growth. The first tools attempt was still estimating its initial large input at timeout.
rootEvidence.notEstablished: No proof of O(N²) tree rebuilding, a production leak or physical-I/O dominance is claimed. formatFill.ts coldFill already streams through bulkBuildRowTree. The unchanged sampler repeatedly forces settling while asynchronous estimation/fact fill is pending. This coupling is observed, but CPU/I/O/GC attribution needs profiling without changing the acceptance schedule.
rootEvidence.next: Profile the cold native token-format fill under the exact existing sampler and use a failing bounded public behavior test before any production optimization. Do not pre-fill large, drop pairs, change GC/sampling, add attempts, or increase timeouts.

limits: Original-protocol six-send retention and all four memory controls remain unaccepted if interrupted by timeout. Timeout/route/runtime failure is never counted as memory sensitivity.
